note: Owner-curated Redux section copy. Steps come from README.md and docs/INSTALL.md. Option labels are checked against cmd/ultimav/audio_settings_dialog_rendering.go at build time.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Get the archive for macOS, Windows or Linux from the releases page. Check it against SHA256SUMS and extract all of it.

steps.title: Bring the original
steps.text: You need the complete MS-DOS PC game folder, such as the GOG edition. The Amiga, Atari ST, Commodore 64 and Apple II versions use different files.

steps.title: Run it
steps.text: Start ultimav. First-run setup looks for your game folder, or tells you where to copy it.

steps.title: Bring a save (optional)
steps.text: The title menu imports SAVED.GAM and SAVED.OOL from your game folder. A converter handles saves kept elsewhere.

options.label: Repeated Monster Division
options.effect: Original: surviving Slimes and Gargoyles can divide repeatedly. Off keeps Redux's one-child split limit; On restores repeated division.

options.label: Remember Hidden Dungeon Discoveries
options.effect: Remember discovered hidden doors and pits between visits. On keeps discoveries. Off resets them each fresh visit.

options.label: Show Subdued Unlit Dungeons
options.effect: Original: an unlit dungeon viewport is black. On shows subdued geometry without granting light; Off restores binary darkness.

options.label: Batch Merchant Theft
options.effect: On: one Faulinei theft per paid batch. Off: original theft per item, bundle or patient; theft can stop a batch early.

options.label: Smooth Surface Movement
options.effect: Scroll while walking, riding, flying or boating. Mounts animate 25% faster. Gameplay timing, combat and dungeons are unchanged.

options.label: Concealed Turn Slots
options.effect: On reserves blank NEXT slots for concealed enemies. Off compacts the four-action forecast to avoid revealing hidden actors. Scheduling is unchanged.

options.label: Flexible Sextant Use
options.effect: Day or night, including surface settlement interiors. A Sextant is required; no dungeons or Underworld. Off: night use on the world map.

options.label: Ankh Visit Bonus
options.effect: A folk tale says an Ankh draws Lord British to your camp. There's no evidence the original did this, but it's here if you enjoy the idea. On: each living party member wearing an Ankh adds 5% to the 25% visit chance. Off: the original 25%.

options.label: Combat Speed
options.effect: Change how quickly combat actions and animations play. 1x is normal speed; higher values make combat faster.

options.label: Confirm Quick Save
options.effect: Ask before saving with Q. On asks first; Off saves immediately. Q saves to the last slot you loaded or saved. Default: On.

options.label: Show Combat HP Bars
options.effect: Show health bars during combat. Off hides the bars and adds injury descriptions to the battle report. Default: On.

options.label: Maximum Action Popups
options.effect: Choose how many action messages can appear over the map at once. Off hides them; messages still appear in the lower-right text area.

credits.title: Bundled art, sound and fonts
credits.text: Each has its own terms, listed in Asset credits.

credits.title: The original game
credits.text: Not included. You use your own copy.
